{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|exec= spawn
|gr1= VR

|descr= Delete body of a virtual soldier after he's killed.

|s1= [object, instant, delay] call [[BIS_fnc_VREffectKilled]]

|p1= object: [[Object]] - object
|p2= instant: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to delete the body right away, [[false]] to add '''killed''' [[addEventHandler|EH]] which will delete it after death
|p3= delay: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 10) time in seconds before the body disappears

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] when the function is done

|x1= <sqf>[player] call BIS_fnc_VREffectKilled;</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>[player, true, 5] spawn BIS_fnc_VREffectKilled;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Virtual Reality Custom Courses|Arma 3 VR Custom Courses]] [[:Category:Function Group: VR|VR functions]]
}}
